map.由主半径与管半径求环体体积 使用指南: Torus Volume from Major and Minor Radius User Guide
map.输入环面的主半径 R（到管中心距离）与管半径 r，使用公式 V=2·π²·R·r: Enter the major radius R of a torus (to the centre of the tube) and the minor radius r, and compute the volume with V = 2·π²·R·r², for estimating the capacity of doughnut-shaped parts, pipe elbows or torus bodies in mathematical models.
map.输入主半径 R（到管中心）与管半径 r，求环体体积。: Enter the major radius R (to the tube centre) and the minor radius r to compute the torus volume.
map.环面零件：管道弯头、环形密封件容积: Torus parts: pipe elbows and annular seal volumes
map.数学模型：环体体积与管径的平方关系: Mathematical models: the square relationship between torus volume and tube diameter
map.：算法：环体体积 V=2π²·R·r²，R 为主半径（圆心到管中心）、r 为管半: Algorithm: torus volume V = 2π²·R·r², where R is the major radius (centre to tube centre) and r is the minor radius. It equals the tube cross-section area πr² times the circumference 2πR traced by the centre. R and r must both be positive.
map.：例：R=5m、r=1m → V=2π²×5×1=98.696 m³。若 r=2: Example: R = 5 m and r = 1 m give V = 2π²×5×1 = 98.696 m³. If r = 2 m with the same R = 5, then V = 2π²×5×4 = 394.784 m³, since doubling the tube diameter quadruples the volume because of the r² term.
map.R 和 r 别搞混？: Do not confuse R and r.
map.R 是\"大半径\"（圆环中心圈）、r 是\"小管半径\"（管粗细）；管截面是半: R is the major radius (the central ring of the torus) and r is the minor radius (the tube thickness). The tube cross-section is a circle of radius r, and sweeping its centre along a circle of radius R forms the torus.
map.环体表面积 S=4π²Rr；与体积类似（截面积周长 2πr × 绕行周长 2πR: The surface area is S = 4π²Rr, derived similarly to the volume (cross-section circumference 2πr times the swept circumference 2πR). This tool gives the volume; compute the area separately with this formula.
